skill.obsidian_ef_compat.obsidian_impale: Thrust your arm straight at your crosshair as it and the gauntlet stretch into a tapered obsidian spike nearly 9 blocks long, impaling everything in its path for 60 damage that ignores armor.
skill.obsidian_ef_compat.twin_meteor.too: Dual wield only. Hammer out six alternating punches, then leap and drive both gauntlets into the ground in a shattering slam that knocks enemies down.
skill.obsidian_ef_compat.obsidian_stretc: Your obsidian body stretches from where you stand to where you're going, then snaps you there: up to 7 blocks in the direction of your movement keys, taken from where you're looking (look up or down to dash up or down; no key dashes straight where you look). Stops short of walls, works in the air, and you can't be hit while stretched. No stamina cost and no cooldown.
